answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 87 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in umber, queued in pulse, and jetty publishes the wait time. A farm of 302 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2881 identities would post 3421 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
